name: mri2cbct_resample
description: Resample MRI and CBCT to uniform spacing. Interpolates medical images to isotropic or anisotropic target resolution for standardized processing and compatibility with subsequent deep learning or analysis pipelines.

parameters.name: input_folder_MRI
parameters.description: Folder containing MRI scans to resample.

parameters.name: input_folder_T2_MRI
parameters.description: Folder containing MRI T2 scans to resample.

parameters.name: input_folder_CBCT
parameters.description: Folder containing CBCT scans to resample.

parameters.name: input_folder_T2_CBCT
parameters.description: Folder containing CBCT T2 scans to resample.

parameters.name: input_folder_Seg
parameters.description: Folder containing Seg scans to resample.

parameters.name: input_folder_T2_Seg
parameters.description: Folder containing Seg T2 scans to resample.

parameters.name: resample_size
parameters.description: list for the resample size of the scans

parameters.name: spacing
parameters.description: list for the spacing size of the scans
